diagnosis: deterministic spatial mean preserves compiled shape and route safety but oversmooths or closes rare small cross-sections; the already-preregistered correlated flow residual now receives its exact noise and selection contract
base_checkpoints: the 12 frozen whole-cave spatial checkpoints in cw7-spatial-transformer-inference-binding-v1.json
residual_target: 17x17 bilinear downsample of measured tangent SDF minus frozen base mean tangent SDF

flow_path.x0: per-token seeded Gaussian noise, one 3x3 average-pool smoothing pass, per-plane unit RMS
flow_path.integration: 8 fixed midpoint-time Euler steps from t=0 to 1

training.source_sampling: equal patch count per available training cave

development_sampling.selection_arm: mean field of the three frozen samples after quantization

validation_temperature_selection: after final all-development flow weights freeze, maximize Faux Monnayeurs cross-section sign IoU with offset fixed at -0.075; no weight updates
gates: unchanged parent CW7 development, safety, diversity, validation, and sealed-confirmation gates
claim_limit: registered stochastic residual arm on 12 named development caves; no validation or sealed model access before weights freeze
